sub_graphs.title: Prague CREATE/CREATE2: Contract Creation Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of contract creation through CREATE and CREATE2 opcodes from initiation to deployment

nodes.label: CREATE/CREATE2 Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: The EVM has fetched a CREATE or CREATE2 opcode and is ready to execute

nodes.label: Pop Creation Parameters
nodes.description: Pop endowment, memory offset, size (and salt for CREATE2) from the stack

nodes.label: Creation Parameters Ready
nodes.description: All parameters for contract creation have been extracted from stack

nodes.label: Compute Contract Address
nodes.description: Calculate new contract address: CREATE uses sender+nonce, CREATE2 uses sender+salt+init_code_hash

nodes.label: Contract Address Computed
nodes.description: The address for the new contract has been determined

nodes.label: Validate Creation Preconditions
nodes.description: Check sufficient balance, nonce limits not exceeded, stack depth within bounds

nodes.label: Preconditions Failed
nodes.description: One or more preconditions for contract creation failed

nodes.label: Preconditions Passed
nodes.description: All preconditions for contract creation are satisfied

nodes.label: Process Create Message
nodes.description: Execute the initialization code to deploy the contract via process_create_message

nodes.label: Init Code Executing
nodes.description: The contract initialization code is being executed

nodes.label: Init Code Succeeded
nodes.description: Initialization code executed successfully, contract deployed

nodes.label: Init Code Failed
nodes.description: Initialization code reverted or ran out of gas

nodes.label: Push Result to Stack
nodes.description: Push the new contract address (success) or 0 (failure) to the stack

nodes.label: CREATE Complete
nodes.description: CREATE/CREATE2 instruction has completed, result on stack

sub_graphs.title: Prague CALL Variants: Message Call Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of message calls through CALL, CALLCODE, DELEGATECALL, and STATICCALL opcodes

nodes.label: CALL Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: The EVM has fetched a CALL variant opcode (CALL, CALLCODE, DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL)

nodes.label: Pop Call Parameters
nodes.description: Pop gas, address, value (where applicable), and memory I/O specifications from stack

nodes.label: Call Parameters Ready
nodes.description: All parameters for message call have been extracted from stack

nodes.label: Check Stack Depth Limit
nodes.description: Verify that call stack depth is within the 1024 limit

nodes.label: Stack Depth Exceeded
nodes.description: Call cannot proceed because stack depth limit is reached

nodes.label: Stack Depth OK
nodes.description: Stack depth is within limits, call can proceed

nodes.label: Construct Child Message
nodes.description: Build the child execution message with appropriate context based on call variant

nodes.label: Child Message Ready
nodes.description: Child message is constructed with correct caller, value, and code context

nodes.label: Process Message
nodes.description: Execute the child message through process_message

nodes.label: Child Execution in Progress
nodes.description: The child message is being executed

nodes.label: Child Execution Succeeded
nodes.description: Child execution completed successfully

nodes.label: Child Execution Reverted
nodes.description: Child execution reverted

nodes.label: Incorporate Results
nodes.description: Copy return data to memory and update parent state based on child results

nodes.label: Push Call Result
nodes.description: Push 1 (success) or 0 (failure) to the stack

nodes.label: CALL Complete
nodes.description: CALL variant instruction has completed, result on stack

sub_graphs.title: Prague SELFDESTRUCT: Account Termination
sub_graphs.description: Models the SELFDESTRUCT operation that transfers balance and marks account for deletion

nodes.label: SELFDESTRUCT Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: The EVM has fetched a SELFDESTRUCT opcode

nodes.label: Pop Beneficiary Address
nodes.description: Pop the beneficiary address from the stack

nodes.label: Beneficiary Address Known
nodes.description: The address to receive remaining balance is determined

nodes.label: Check if Created in Transaction
nodes.description: Verify if the contract was created within the current transaction

nodes.label: Created in This Transaction
nodes.description: Contract was created in current transaction, can be destroyed

nodes.label: Not Created in This Transaction
nodes.description: Contract existed before this transaction

nodes.label: Transfer Remaining Balance
nodes.description: Transfer all remaining Ether balance to the beneficiary

nodes.label: Balance Transferred
nodes.description: All remaining balance has been sent to beneficiary

nodes.label: Mark Account for Deletion
nodes.description: Register the account to be deleted at end of transaction

nodes.label: Account Marked for Deletion
nodes.description: Account will be removed at transaction finalization

nodes.label: Halt Execution
nodes.description: Stop execution of the current context

nodes.label: SELFDESTRUCT Complete
nodes.description: SELFDESTRUCT has executed, execution halted

edges.label: Mark for deletion (if created in tx)

sub_graphs.title: Prague RETURN/REVERT: Execution Termination
sub_graphs.description: Models how RETURN and REVERT opcodes terminate execution and handle output data

nodes.label: RETURN/REVERT Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: The EVM has fetched a RETURN or REVERT opcode

nodes.label: Pop Memory Boundaries
nodes.description: Pop memory offset and size from the stack

nodes.label: Memory Boundaries Known
nodes.description: The output data region in memory is specified

nodes.label: Expand Memory for Output
nodes.description: Expand memory if needed to read the output region

nodes.label: Read Output Data
nodes.description: Read the specified bytes from memory as output data

nodes.label: Output Data Ready
nodes.description: Output data has been read from memory

nodes.label: Set EVM Output
nodes.description: Store the output data in the EVM for caller to access

nodes.label: Raise Revert Exception
nodes.description: For REVERT: raise exception to trigger state rollback

nodes.label: RETURN Complete
nodes.description: RETURN executed successfully, output available

nodes.label: REVERT Complete
nodes.description: REVERT executed, state changes rolled back, output available

sub_graphs.title: Prague System Instructions: Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculations for CREATE, CALL variants, and other system instructions

nodes.label: System Instruction Gas Input
nodes.description: Parameters for gas calculation are available

nodes.label: Calculate Base Gas Cost
nodes.description: Apply base gas cost (GAS_CREATE for creation, access costs for calls)

nodes.label: Check Warm/Cold Access
nodes.description: Determine if target address is warm (previously accessed) or cold

nodes.label: Warm Access
nodes.description: Target address is in access list, lower gas cost

nodes.label: Cold Access
nodes.description: Target address is not in access list, higher gas cost

nodes.label: Apply Warm Access Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_WARM_ACCESS (100 gas)

nodes.label: Apply Cold Access Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS (2600 gas)

nodes.label: Calculate Value Transfer Gas
nodes.description: Add GAS_CALL_VALUE if value > 0

nodes.label: Calculate New Account Gas
nodes.description: Add GAS_NEW_ACCOUNT if creating a new account with value

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Add gas for memory expansion based on I/O ranges

nodes.label: Calculate Init Code Gas
nodes.description: For CREATE: add gas proportional to init code size

nodes.label: Total System Gas Computed
nodes.description: Final gas cost for system instruction is determined

ambiguities.text: The exact gas forwarding rules for CALL variants (63/64 rule) are not explicitly detailed
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the standard 63/64 gas forwarding rule applies: at most 63/64 of remaining gas can be forwarded to child calls.

ambiguities.text: Specific behavior when CALLCODE or DELEGATECALL targets an empty account is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume execution succeeds with empty code, returning immediately with no state changes.

ambiguities.text: The term 'nonce limits' in CREATE preconditions is not precisely defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nonce limit is 2^64 - 1 as per EIP-2681.

implicit_assumptions.description: Stack depth limit of 1024 is always enforced before executing child calls
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could enable stack overflow attacks or resource exhaustion through deep call chains

implicit_assumptions.description: The computed CREATE2 address is deterministic and collision-resistant
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Address collisions could allow contract replacement or fund theft

implicit_assumptions.description: SELFDESTRUCT only marks for deletion contracts created in the same transaction (EIP-6780)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Legacy SELFDESTRUCT behavior could enable unexpected balance manipulation

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot predict nonces to front-run CREATE and deploy malicious code at expected addresses
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Factory contract address prediction could be exploited
